title: Restrict SDF sampling to conservative root-envelope candidates
description: Performance continuation under TSK-0008 / TSK-0065. DensityGrid currently preserves a full-volume sample array and uses the root potential envelope only as an in-loop early exit, so every grid corner is still visited. Use the already-computed conservative root potential envelope to initialize the sample buffer to +inf and evaluate only a conservatively expanded integer candidate box. Retain the existing per-point envelope check inside the candidate job as a proof guard. Fall back to full-volume sampling when no root potential envelope exists. Preserve exact field values, +inf absent semantics, deterministic sample addresses, and topology.

comments.author: ChatGPT
comments.body: Implementation started in the 2026-09-10 performance round. The implementation uses the existing SdfProgram.HasPotentialBounds / PotentialMinBound / PotentialMaxBound contract; no new approximate geometry is introduced. Unity parity and fresh editor timing remain required before completion.
